# The Bootbreaker

*A shore crab the size of a fishing boat moults in the Pinch, the Old Cut's deepest lock, and its young are the bootcrabs. Watch the floor for its claw slams; when the tide floods the lock, keep your feet. Potions work in the Pinch Lock; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [The Bootbreaker](../monsters/bootbreaker.md) |
| Arena | [The Pinch Lock](../maps/pinch_lock.md) |

- Unlocked by [Kit on the Lock Gate](../quests/alwyn_kit_on_the_lock_gate.md)
- Entered by talking to [Old Lock Post](../npcs/pinch_lock_gate.md)
